record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.context_brief: Converses to four Hilbert-space fixed point criteria
record.original_question: A cited result states that a nonexpansive representation of a semitopological semigroup S on a nonempty closed convex subset C of a Hilbert space has a common fixed point in C whenever there exists c in C with bounded orbit {T_s c : s in S} and one of the following holds: (i) C_b(S) has a left invariant mean and s -> T_s c is continuous from S into (C, weak topology); (ii) S is left amenable and the action is weakly jointly continuous; (iii) AP(S) has a left invariant mean and the action is weakly separately continuous and weakly equicontinuous; or (iv) WAP(S) has a left invariant mean and the action is weakly separately continuous and weakly quasi-equicontinuous. In any of these four cases, does the converse hold?

evidence.quote: It was also shown in [16, Theorem 4.3] that a nonexpansive representation of a semitopological semigroup S on a nonempty closed convex subset C of a Hilbert space H has a common fixed point in C if there is c ∈ C such that {Tsc : s ∈ S} is bounded and any of the following conditions holds:

(i) Cb(S) has a left invariant mean and the mapping s 7→ Tsc is continuous from S into (C, wk); (ii) S is left amenable and the action of S on C is weakly jointly continuous; (iii) AP(S) has a left invariant mean and the action of S on C is weakly sepa￾rately continuous and weakly equicontinuous continuous; (iv) W AP(S) has a left invariant mean and the action of S on C is weakly separately continuous and weakly quasi-equicontinuous.
Problem 2.10. In any of the cases in the above result, does the converse also hold?

artifact.status_search_result: A web search located related results characterizing left invariance of means via fixed point properties on weakly compact convex sets in Banach spaces (notably for $WAP(S)$ when $S$ has an identity), but no direct published resolution of the four converses in the specific Hilbert-space, bounded-orbit, closed-convex setting was found. The status of each of the four converses appears unresolved in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Fixed Point Properties and Q-Nonexpansive Retractions in Locally Convex Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses converses for fixed point properties involving WAP(S) and left invariant means in Banach space settings.
status_evidence.claim: Converse-type characterizations exist in Banach space settings but do not directly resolve the Hilbert-space converses in question.

status_evidence.title: Fixed point properties for semigroups of nonlinear mappings on unbounded sets
status_evidence.snippet: Studies common fixed points for semigroup representations under amenability hypotheses.
status_evidence.claim: Forward implications are established; converses for the four listed conditions are not addressed.
